description: Save the whole world (every session's files and label, players, items, chat, peripherals, a turtle's blocks, the time of day) under a name, list the saved ones, restore one (each computer reboots into it; sessions that are gone are made again, the viewer's computers made after it are closed, other sessions are left alone; a computer on a person's folder, live, has that folder put back exactly: changed files written back, files made since removed, a copy of each in `folders[].backup`), delete one, or move one as a .craftos-world file: export writes it to `file`, import reads `file`. The browser app's Snapshots button uses the same ones.

file.description: export/import: a path, relative to the workspace

name: craftos_world_snapshot
